# Emergency fund sizing

Subscriptions creep up quietly, so list them all twice a year and cancel the unused ones. Automate savings on payday so the money moves before it can be spent. Rebalance the portfolio once a year rather than reacting to every market headline. Index funds win mostly on fees; a one percent fee compounds into a large loss over decades. The snowball method pays the smallest balance first and builds motivation with quick wins.

## Checklist

- A sinking fund spreads a known future cost, such as a new laptop, across the months before it.
- Track net worth quarterly; the trend matters more than any single month.
- The avalanche method pays the highest interest debt first and saves the most money.
- Subscriptions creep up quietly, so list them all twice a year and cancel the unused ones.
- Automate savings on payday so the money moves before it can be spent.
